study.title: Example Audit Response Rating Study
study.description: For each organization, compare two synthetic responses shown in random order. Select the response you prefer and explain why.
study.participant_help: Use the exact same ID if you return later so the app can restore your progress.
study.comparison_instructions: Both messages are synthetic examples from the same organization. Read both before rating them.
study.reason_question: Why is the response you preferred more helpful?
